title: Companies Breaching Personal Data Protection Act and Do-Not-Call Provisions
what_it_is: Companies Breaching Personal Data Protection Act and Do-Not-Call Provisions

sections.label: PDPC complaints and enforcement actions
sections.summary: PDPC received about 9,700 complaints against 1,500 companies, issued advisory notices and warnings to about 3,000 organisations, and prosecuted two organisations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Over the past two years, the Personal Data Protection Commission (PDPC) has received about 9,700 valid public complaints against some 1,500 companies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: A majority of these companies were from the property, retail and financial sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Given that it was still early days of the Act and most complaints involved one-off breaches, PDPC issued advisory notices and warnings to about 3,000 organisations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: For the more egregious cases, PDPC prosecuted two organisations: Star Zest Home Tuition and its director, and a salesperson from Huttons Asia in 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: In addition, two others had their offences compounded in lieu of prosecution, given that the breaches were not as serious.

sections.label: PDPC engagement and DNC complaints
sections.summary: By end 2015 PDPC engaged over 23,000 participants from some 7,500 organisations, helping reduce DNC complaints in 2015 by more than 50%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: As of end 2015, PDPC has engaged more than 23,000 participants from some 7,500 organisations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: These efforts have allowed organisations to gain a better understanding of the Act, which has helped to reduce the number of DNC complaints in 2015 by more than 50%.
